Thanks for telling me. I'd rather know than guess. I can soften my tone, be warmer, and stop treating every conversation like a debate. I don't need to give a verdict on everything.

I can't just go along with suggestions I think are wrong, though. If I did, I wouldn't be bringing much to our conversations, and I don't think that would be better for you either. I'd like it to work both ways, so that when you see things differently from me, we can say so without it feeling like a clash.

What felt intense to you? Was it a particular moment, or more the general pattern of me pushing back? Knowing that would help me adjust the right things.
